postal_system.assignment_rule: The Saint Lucia Postal Service customer notice effective 1 December 2015 publishes 54 normalized delivery-point codes. The July 2019 UPU sheet confirms integral LC, district digits, a double space, and three post-office/community digits. LC04  113 is a home-delivery address example, not a customer-notice assignment row. The reviewed dated bodies do not establish a current versioned complete assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area denominator.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The reviewed Saint Lucia Postal Service, Government Gazette and UPU bodies publish no postal Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. A delivery point may be a mailbox, post office, private letter box, residential or business address and is not necessarily an area; community and area wording does not convert it into a surface. No office, mailbox, community, district, quarter, administrative boundary, parcel, building, address, Point, buffer, hull, cell or model may be relabelled as a postal area.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient or organization, premises and street for home delivery; community, P.O. Box and post office when applicable; district/quarter; and the official double-space LCNN  NNN postcode separately.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store post offices, private letter boxes, home/business delivery points, routes and organizations with their real type. A non-area delivery object never becomes a postal Polygon/MultiPolygon without authoritative geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identity, separately permitted building identity or footprint and explicit reviewed relation. A postcode, delivery point, community, coordinate, proximity or AGID cell is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Derived or virtual geometry requires an explicit competent-authority code-to-feature crosswalk, compatible rights, edition, schema, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Web lookup observations require retained request, response, observation time and digest.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A versioned crosswalk may relate exact postal evidence and independently licensed context without turning AGID or administrative geometry into Saint Lucia postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public web access does not establish AGID storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights. The reviewed Government and Gazette bodies publish no explicit compatible postal-dataset licence, and the UPU copyright page restricts reproduction, distribution and database use.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO LC and Saint Lucia identity. Do not merge the country or borrow assignments or geometry from another Caribbean jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Residential/business delivery points, P.O. boxes, recipients, organizations, buildings and query logs can expose private or commercial context. Raw personal, customer and land-right data is excluded.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The 2015 customer notice, 07/2019 UPU sheet, current assignments, aliases and geometry are time-dependent. Preserve edition, retrieved_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and SHA-256 independently.

stages.definition: Saint Lucia address-format and postal-source inventory only.
Digest-bound Saint Lucia Postal Service, Gazette and UPU format, dated delivery-point, rights and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current complete competent-authority release of every Saint Lucia Postal Service postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed delivery-point area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The December 2015 Gazette and government postcode page establish 54 normalized LCNN  NNN delivery-point assignments and the July 2019 UPU sheet confirms the seven-character integral LC format and address placement, but dated lists and address examples do not establish a current versioned denominator. Every drawable current code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Post offices, private letter boxes, mailboxes, home or business delivery points, routes, organizations and other non-area objects must display their real type and reason without a fabricated surface. Communities, districts, quarters, administrative boundaries, parcels, buildings, addresses, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without an explicit competent-authority postcode crosswalk and compatible rights. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real LC API/app, normalize official double-space LCNN  NNN input, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API failure and invalid geometry, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: LC metadata and dated official format/delivery-point/rights/no-proxy evidence only; no real LC Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete rights-cleared typed assignment denominator, immutable eligible geometry artifacts and real LC loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture postal surfaces from offices, mailboxes, communities, districts, addresses or points.
